name: quality-inspection
description: Quality inspection boilerplate — React + Express + PostgreSQL

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.audit: npm audit --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix server --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix client --audit-level=high
scripts.precommit: npm run format && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run audit
